description: Update multiple macros in Zendesk in a single request. Use when you need to bulk update macro settings such as position or active status for multiple macros at once. This action is idempotent — re-running with the same parameters will produce the same result.

inputSchema.description: Request to update multiple macros in Zendesk.

macros.description: List of macros to update. Each macro must include an 'id' and can optionally include 'position' and 'active'.
macros.human_parameter_description: An array of macro objects to update. Each object requires an 'id' field and can optionally include 'position' and 'active'.

items.description: Individual macro update item for bulk update.

active.description: Whether to activate (true) or deactivate (false) the macro
active.human_parameter_description: Set to true to activate the macro or false to deactivate it.
active.title: Active

id.description: The ID of the macro to update
id.human_parameter_description: The unique ID of the Zendesk macro you want to update. You can find macro IDs from the List Macros action.
id.title: Id

position.description: The new position of the macro in the list
position.human_parameter_description: Set the new position of the macro in the list (lower numbers appear first).
position.title: Position

items.title: MacroUpdateItem

macros.title: Macros

name: update_many_macros

conditions.title: Conditions
